Gulf Coast Refinery Crisis

The Gulf Coast conflict in Compromised, where attacks on food convoys and refineries conceal a rogue-agent operation.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-27

A supply crisis becomes a rogue operation

The initial crisis concerns the food and fuel links that keep Gulf Coast communities supplied. The novel later reframes the clash between the Reborn and the Molossi as an operation directed by rogue agents. [1]

Battleship Texas

The major confrontation moves to Battleship Texas, linking the regional power struggle to stored Eclipse Virus payloads. [1]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    Compromised begins its Gulf Coast crisis with attacks on the southern food-convoy network and a threat to Texas refinery infrastructure relied on by survivor communities. [1]

  2. confirmed

    The novel reveals that rogue agents supply the Reborn and coerce Marcus Georgio, using the conflict to advance control over the region's refinery communities. [1]

  3. confirmed

    The conflict culminates in an intervention at Battleship Texas, where the rogue operation is connected to stored Eclipse Virus payloads. [1]
